scripts.migrate: docker run --rm --network monorepo-net -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://admin:admin@postgres:5432/monorepodb -v %cd%/..:/app node:20-alpine sh -c "cd /app/database && npx prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma"
scripts.seed:docker: docker run --rm --network monorepo-net -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://admin:admin@postgres:5432/monorepodb -e ADMIN_PASSWORD=%ADMIN_PASSWORD% -v %cd%/..:/app node:20-alpine sh -c "cd /app/database && npm run seed"
